arts.ttl: Why Thibaut Courtois is out of Olympiacos vs Real Madrid in the Champions League as a mini crisis unfolds
arts.sum: Real Madrid’s Tuesday training session at Valdebebas delivered more problems than solutions before the team boards its early afternoon flight to Greece. Thibaut Courtois will miss Wednesday’s Champions League matchup against Olympiacos after leaving the Ciudad Real Madrid facility with a bout of gastroenteritis that prevented him from taking part in the session.
